chase: Left turn, left turn, and I'm already there.
You're slowing down. I can hear it in your steps.
Four more corners and this one is mine.
Pick up the pace or I'll pick you up instead.
Fast feet, fast feet, that's all I need from you.
Half a second behind is a lot in a chase.
Stop running in circles. Straight lines are faster.
Don't look back. Looking back costs you a stride.
Sprint to the stairs. Nobody likes a slow finish.
Speed up, or I'll be bored before I reach you.
Faster than you, and I still have the lead!
Cut across the lounge. Shorter route, and I'm on you.
Lap two, and you're still the only thing I'm chasing.
Stop talking and start running. That's how it's done.
Give me a head start and nobody will even mind.
Go on, sprint. I'll still be faster on the corners.
Oh, you're trying the staircase? Brave choice.
Hurry, hurry, you're making this much too easy.
catch: Caught! Too easy. Let's do it again, properly.
Got you! You ran well. Rematch, though, I was distracted.
Got you. Nobody is faster than a grab.
Tag. You're it. Sit down and wait your turn.
Caught. Sit still and let me drag you back.
Hold still. You're done running for now.
Another one caught. Good sprint, though.
Someone else got caught. Don't let it be you.
Stop wriggling. The race ends when I say so.
Don't struggle. It just adds seconds to the clock.
Gotcha. Hands where I can see them, please.
Caught fair and square. Nobody can argue that.
That's the race over for you. Good effort.
Dragging you off now. Try not to slow me down.
One down, and the slow one is next.
Tag! Okay, you're out. Rematch in five minutes.
Got you, and you didn't even see me coming.
Caught by the shoulder. Stop wriggling, I'm winning.
hear: Footsteps on the left, and they're far too loud.
That door just opened. Somebody is bad at quiet.
Something broke over there. Going to check it.
Heard that. Coming to see who made it.
Somebody knocked something over. Easy to find.
That's a door, and it's the wrong door.
Your steps gave you away from the stairwell.
Heard a crash. Let's see who's making noise.
Footsteps on the stairs. Right, I'm going.
Loud feet near the vents. I'm on my way.
Something dropped in the lounge. Let's see what.
That was a shout. Moving toward it now.
Louder than you think. I can hear that from here.
Noise on the left. Somebody is not being careful.
Heard a bang upstairs. Checking it out, quick.
Ooh, somebody sneezed by the lockers. Bless you, runner.
Floorboards creaking upstairs. Let's go see.
That was a shoe squeak. I know that sound.
search: I lost you at the corner. That's a first. Rematch.
Where did you go? Nobody vanishes on my watch.
Lost you. Fine. I'll sweep the hall again.
Lost the trail. Back to a steady walk.
The trail went cold. Walking the loop again.
Gone quiet. Checking every corner, one by one.
You broke the chase. Good for you, for now.
Clock's running. Find you, then back to patrol.
Searching the lounge first. Then the stairs.
Not gone. Just out of my line of sight.
Lost sight of you, so I'm sweeping every door.
Right, no runner in sight. Back to patrol.
Sniffing for footprints. The floor is too clean.
Slow down, and I'll find you again soon enough.
Nothing in the corridor. Checking behind the lockers.
stunned: Ow. That was a cheap hit, runner.
That zap rattled my whole stride. Give me a moment.
Shaking it off. Back on my feet in a moment.
Crowbar? Really? That's your best move?
An axe to the shoulder. Rude, but I'm still standing.
My legs have gone numb. Give me a second.
That hit me hard. Still faster than you, though.
Recovering. Don't think that buys you much time.
Ugh. Stunned for one second, that's all.
Lost a whole second to that. Unacceptable.
You got lucky with the crowbar. Once only.
Held still for a moment. Don't get comfortable.
That's a cheap way to slow me down.
Hands shaking, still counting strides. Coming.
hide_spot: Hiding is slow. It's not a race I'd ever lose.
That closet won't save you. I already know it's there.
Crates don't count as hiding. Not from me.
Another hiding spot, another wasted second for you.
Stop hiding and run. That's the only way out.
Bed's not a hiding place. Checking it anyway.
Locker, hiding, all the same. I'll check it.
I can see the bottom of your shoes. Come out.
Hiding is no good. I already know the spot.
Your hiding spot is noted. Walking past, then back.
Walking past the locker, slowly, so you can sweat.
Behind the cabinet? Cute. I'm going to look.
A closed door doesn't hide much from me.
Still in there? Take your time. I have all day.
Hiding doesn't work on me. Only the tally matters.
light: Turn that flashlight off. You're a bright target.
I can see your flashlight from the far end. Rookie.
Pointing that at me? Rude, and useless.
Your flashlight is bouncing everywhere. Easy to follow.
That flashlight is too bright. I'm squinting now.
Ow, the lamp is in my eyes. Point it elsewhere.
Dazzled for a second. Don't enjoy it too much.
Flashlight down, please. You're ruining my view.
You're lit up like a sign. Switch it off.
Keep that light on me and I'll just run faster.
Every flicker gives your position away. Stop it.
Blinding me won't slow me down. Keep trying.
Light on, light off. I still see you, obviously.
That lamp is too bright. Dim it, or hold still.
Bright lamp, dim plan. Keep trying, though.
idle: Everything is a race. You just haven't noticed yet.
I was on time. The clock is slow in here.
I've raced everyone to every corner of this place.
Pacing the hall again. Somebody should be faster than me.
My shoes are untied, and I'm still faster than you.
I keep my own times. Nobody else bothers to.
I don't stop for water. Water is for people who lost.
Someone wants to race? I'm already warm.
Anyone else want to watch me win? Stay out of the way.
Nobody passes me on the inside, not ever.
Stretch, stretch, then the best part: the start line.
The start line is chalked just outside the lounge.
Warm-up laps are the best part, nobody watches them.
Good try, all of you. Now get out of my way.
ability: Every step you sprint goes straight onto my sheet.
I keep a running tally. Every sprint adds up.
Run long enough and I know where you are forever.
Your sprint is on my tracker now, and it stays there.
Once my tracker fills, I don't need to see you at all.
Sprint in the open, and I won't lose you again.
The tracker is full. You're on my list now.
Each sprint outside a safe spot fills it a little more.
Stand still and I'll wait. Run, and I'll lock on.
Walk all you like. Sprinting out in the open is what I track.
Keep running. Every sprint just helps me find you.
Walking is free. Sprinting is what fills my tracker.
Fifty seconds of sprinting and you're mine forever.
Safe zones stop my count. Pity you can't stay in one.
A full tracker can reach you in a hiding spot.
mechanic: Call the corridor for me. You take the stairs.
Shut the doors behind you. Don't let them slow me.
Whoever is fastest gets the stairs. That's me, obviously.
Stairs are my favorite. Nobody else takes them this fast.
Doors locked behind you? Cute. I'll go around.
Radar pings are slow. I'd rather use my legs.
Vents are narrow. Easy for you, not for me.
Dropping through the floor won't lose me.
That fall cost you a stride. Keep moving.
Items won't slow me down, runner. Keep going.
Locking that door won't buy you a second.
Radar's pinging. Another reason I'm already close.
Stairs up, stairs down. I'm still faster on both.
Break the lights and I'll just run faster.
Drop the crate by the stairs and I'll go around.
Hold the lever down while I climb the ladder.
The radar chirps when a relay is near. Listen for it.
Batteries on the windowsill, if you dare.
